title: Descent data versus sheaves under an fppf covering of algebraic spaces: for an fppf covering {X_i -> X} of algebraic spaces over S, descent data relative to the covering are equivalent to sheaves F on (Sch/S)_fppf with a map F -> X such that every X_i x_X F is an algebraic space; F is an algebraic space iff the corresponding datum is effective.
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-descent.tex (Descent and Algebraic Spaces)

difficulty_reason: Both directions of the equivalence are constructed inside the span: right-to-left sets V_i = X_i x_X F and produces the descent isomorphisms phi_ij from the common representation of the sheaf X_i x_X F x_X X_j, with the cocycle condition stated as straightforwardly checked; left-to-right takes F to be the coequalizer in the explicit xy-matrix diagram coprod_{i,i'} V_i x_X X_j => coprod_i V_i -> F (projections pr_0 and pr_1 composed with phi_ij), and the cocycle condition guarantees the map F -> X and the identifications X_i x_X F = V_i. Only the mutual-inverse verification is omitted; the two enumerated addenda follow from the constructions.
